To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the naive pairwise feature concatenation is the main bottleneck of SGG; (2) the Align R CNN can effectively align the dynamic object features and boost all the SGG methods; (3) the proposed Align R-CNN can be used to improve the performance of existing SGG models.

the performance of existing SGG models is highly limited by naive feature concatenating and the proposed Align R-CNN can boost the performance of existing models by replacing the naive feature concatenating with the proposed attention based multiple region aligning.
we propose a novel attention based dynamic region alignment module that is able to improve all existing SGG methods by replacing the naive feature concatenations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of how to improve the performance of existing SGG approaches.
the pairwise feature learning for SGG.
how to improve the performance of visual relationship detection and we propose a novel meta architecture learning to solve this problem.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed model can replace naive feature concatenation to boost the SGG performance by learning to align for the object features.
Align R CNN can be a plug-in for existing SGG methods to boost their performance.
the proposed AlignR CNN can be easily integrated into any SGG framework to boost its performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we introduce a novel pairwise feature learning method for SGG, which can be jointly learned with the SGG model.

we introduce an attention based multiple region align module for dynamic object feature alignment, and we show that the proposed module can be jointly trained with SGG to boost the performance of SGG.
we propose an end-to-end meta-architecture learning to align for pairwise feature learning, which is general and can be applied to any existing SGG method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mis aligned object features are a major obstacle in visual relationship prediction.
the performance of SGG can be improved by learning to align object features for dynamic object interaction modeling.
the mis-aligned objects can be easily aligned by a simple attention based module and the resulting object features can be concatenated for relationship prediction.
